# Original Heisenberg parser inputs

Byte-identical copies from `extern/Julia-mVMC/MVMCExpertModeParsers.jl/test/samples/HeisenbergChain/`,
not the different canonical fresh20 runner input. No expected numerical outputs
were generated by Rust. Julia assertion source is
`MVMCExpertModeParsers.jl/test/test_orbital_qptrans_utils.jl`, SHA-256
`fe430c50c3efd22b3007e93cad377a427fcbedf5bc3b47d446a2ae017e65bd01`.

- `orbitalidx.def`: `1d8e8134cb3e2ff7242c74365ea9c8894fbce9b87d2df0d65d836b36f0199828`
- `qptransidx.def`: `25715a81bbc8127724cbd666f55a4c9187c7907240ce03e201989fce963c0d16`

The C authority is `extern/mVMC-1.4.0/src/mVMC/readdef.c`, SHA-256
`9e1f2c635bffb2acdf3210613ab7330c5b28967fae928b303f3b151dfa1b7ef3`:
`GetInfoOrbitalAntiParallel` requires 256 mappings and 64 optimization rows for
Nsite=16; its default sign is +1 and periodic mode forces +1. `GetInfoTransSym`
requires four weight rows and 64 mappings, builds forward/inverse maps, and forces
periodic signs +1. Lines 1398–1403 initialize disabled OptTrans to identity/+1.
The checked-in inputs satisfy these counts; these are source-contract tests, not
an executed native-C reader probe or new Julia runtime validation.

Rust assertions cover M0106–108, M0133–135, M0138–140 and M0142–144 through
the public Expert-mode loader. Availability skips M0104–105/M0131–132 are not
numerical tests. Julia inverse-array assertions M0136–137/M0141 remain outside
the Rust parser API; no test-derived inverse is presented as executed coverage.

Reproduce with `cargo nextest run -p mvmc-expert-parsers --test
issue184_orbital_qptrans_semantics --locked --no-fail-fast --retries 0`.
Normal tests need only these checked-in inputs, not C/Julia runtimes or toolbox.
